title: Beyond Good And Evil 2 Is Still In Development After Ubisoft's Purge - Report
description: Earlier this week, Ubisoft announced sweeping changes to the video game publisher, including the cancelation of six games. The only confirmed title from that group was the remake of Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time. However, a new report indicates that the long-gestating Beyond Good and Evil 2 was not among the games that were purged. According to Insider Gaming, "Beyond Good and Evil 2 is still in active development, at least for the time being." The original Beyond Good and Evil was released in 2003 and it wasn't immediately successful. The sequel didn't officially begin development until May 2008, and that's where it has stayed in the following 17 years. It's believed that Beyond Good and Evil 2's current incarnation has only been in development since 2017, which is still an exceedingly long time for game development. The title has been hit by some setbacks, including the retirement of the game's original director, Michel Ancel, who stepped away from Ubisoft in 2020. In 2023, Beyond Good and Evil 2's creative director, Emile Morel, died suddenly at only 40 years old. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Street Fighter 6 Unleashes Alex's Power Moves In New Gameplay Trailer
description: Until this year, Elena was the only character introduced in Street Fighter 3 to be playable in Street Fighter 6. However, Alex's turn is coming soon, and he's the subject of the latest Street Fighter 6 gameplay trailer from Capcom. AEW fans may have noticed that Alex has adopted some of his pro wrestling moves from Kenny Omega, who performed motion capture for the game. More specifically, Alex is unleashing the V-Trigger knee strike and the One-Winged Angel finishing maneuver. He also seems to favor getting close to his opponents before mercilessly beating them in front of the crowd. Alex is the third DLC character from Street Fighter 6 Year 3, following the release of Sagat and C. Viper in 2025. Last year, Omega starred in the reveal trailer for this group and he cosplayed as all four characters. Alex will make his Street Fighter 6 debut on March 17, while the final character, Ingrid, will be held back for summer. It's currently unknown if Capcom will have four additional DLC characters for Street Fighter 6's fourth year. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Animal Crossing Aquarium Tour Is Coming To The US This Year
description: Last year, Animal Crossing fans in Australia and New Zealand were able to experience an aquarium tour sponsored by Nintendo and Sea Life. Next month, that tour is finally coming to the US with stops across America through the rest of this year. Unlike the previous tour, there will be overlapping Animal Crossing events at multiple Sea Life aquariums. Each location will feature photo ops for fans to appear alongside Animal Crossing: New Horizons' characters in aquatic-themed backgrounds. Fans can also pose alongside standees of Animal Crossing characters, including Kapp'n. The tours will have educational material about the real-life sea creatures living in the aquariums. There will also be specific days where fans can collect Animal Crossing-themed stamps on a card or themed patches, as well as meet-and-greet photo ops with game characters Tom Nook or K.K. Slider. title: Lego's New Smart Play Star Wars Sets Are Now Up for Preorder
description: Lego Star Wars Smart Play: All-in-One Playsets Three interactive playsets with sound and light effects launch March 1. Preorder at Amazon Preorder at Lego Store Preorders are now live for Lego Smart Play, a new system of interactive bricks and minifigures designed to make Lego sets even more immersive. Revealed earlier this year, the line is kicking off with three Star Wars sets: Luke Skywalker's X-Wing ($90), Darth Vader's TIE Fighter ($70), and the Emperor's Throne Room ($160). All three sets will launch on March 1, and they're available to preorder through Amazon and the Lego Store. Lego Star Wars: Darth Vader's TIE Fighter (473 pieces) $70 | Releases March 1 Darth Vader's iconic spaceship set comes with a Smart Minifigure of the Star Wars villain and a Lego Smart Brick. With the Lego Smart Bricks, you can hear the roar of the twin ion engines from the spaceship, and the set also comes with a Rebel Fleet Trooper minifigure, a brick-built Rebel Outpost, and an Imperial Fueling Station. Preorder at Amazon Preorder at Lego Store Lego Star Wars: Luke's Red Five X-wing (584 pieces) $100 | Releases March 1 This set comes with all the pieces you need to build Luke Skywalker's iconic X-Wing fighter, minifigures of Luke and Leia, and special effects like laser-shooting sounds, engine sounds, and lights, plus refueling and repair sounds through the Lego Smart pieces. You can also build an Imperial turret, transporter, command center, and R2-D2. Preorder at Amazon Preorder at Lego Store Lego Star Wars: Throne Room Duel and A-Wing (962 pieces) $160 | Releases March 1 Fans can relive the climactic showdown between Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader from Return of the Jedi with this set. It features lightsaber humming sound effects and A-Wing engine sounds, and when you place the Emperor Palpatine minifigure on its throne, you'll hear the Imperial March theme. The set also comes with a brick-built A-Wing Fighter and pilot minifigure, two Royal Guard minifigures, and a Smart Tag-enabled cannon turret to defend the Emperor's Throne Room. Preorder at Amazon Preorder at Lego Store While this isn't the first time Lego has experimented with electronic components, there are key differences with Smart Play pieces. For starters, they can detect nearby NFC-equipped smart tags and be wirelessly charged. This is a big improvement compared to the Lego Super Mario toys, which required AAA batteries to function. All the pieces work with standard Lego bricks and contain custom-made chips that are smaller than a standard Lego stud. So what do they do exactly? Lego says the Smart Bricks, Smart Tiles, and Smart Tags will respond to actions with appropriate sounds and behaviors, combining to create an interactive experience. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Marathon Will Have A Free Test For Everyone Before Launch
description: If you're curious about Bungie's new shooter Marathon and worried about plunking down $40, Bungie has some welcome news. There will be an "open preview weekend" for the game ahead of launch. Bungie confirmed this on social media, writing, "We'll have an open preview weekend before launch, and everyone will be able to try Marathon out." The wording here suggests this will be free. Marathon has endured multiple controversies already, with Bungie settling a case after art plagiarism allegations, while the studio has also faced questions about whether games like Marathon are remnants of the past. In GameSpot's preview of Marathon from April 2025, GameSpot's Tamoor Hussain said, "A paid game that is light on content but full of hopes, dreams, and ambitions may not be enough to inspire in others the same confidence I have in Bungie." title: New Battlefield 6 Season 2 Map Revealed
description: Before Battlefield 6 Season 2 was pushed back to February 17, the season would have begun today, January 21. While Battlefield 6 players are still waiting to learn what's coming in the new season, a leak on Reddit has revealed that one of the maps is Hagental Airbase in Bravia. In the leaked trailer, NATO forces have lost control of Hagental Airbase, and the voiceover warns that they need to take it back or the momentum of the war will go against them. Some fans on Reddit have complained about the apparent size of the map, and that the airbase doesn't appear to allow jets in battle. Separately, Battlefield 6's social channels revealed Contaminated, a new map for the game that's going to be dropped in Battlefield Labs before it debuts in the primary game. Battlefield Studios also confirmed that it will arrive during Season 2. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Super Mario Galaxy Movie's Chris Pratt Says Trailers So Far Haven't Shown All The Characters
description: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie hasn't revealed all of its secrets just yet. Mario voice actor Chris Pratt has teased that, while trailers so far have featured characters not seen in the first movie like Rosalina and Bowser Jr., fans still haven't seen every character who will be in the sequel. Pratt told GamesRadar that there are multiple new characters who weren't in the 2023 movie that he's excited to see in the next movie. "I'm not allowed to say what they are, but yes, there are some really incredible ... Well, I think some of them have been released in the trailer--Rosalina, Bowser Jr.--and then there's even a couple more that are not in the trailer that people should be excited to see," Pratt said. The Super Mario Galaxy Movie releases in theaters in April 2026. It has massive shoes to fill, as 2023's The Super Mario Bros. Movie earned $1.36 billion worldwide. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Xbox January Update Includes Easier Game-Save Syncs And Arm-PC Support
description: The Xbox PC app, and a majority of Xbox Game Pass PC titles, will now work on Arm-based Windows 11 PCs, Microsoft has announced. The news comes as part of a blog detailing various updates across the Xbox ecosystem this month. Recent improvements like changes to the Prism emulator that runs x86/x64 software on Arm devices to support AVX and AVX2, as well as Epic Anti-Cheat support, means more modern games are now capable of running on Arm-based Windows PC devices, according to Microsoft. While not all games will work, Xbox states more than 85% of titles available on Game Pass will, and that it is working with partners to further expand that number. Games that are not yet supported to run locally can still be played on Arm-based devices using Xbox Cloud Gaming. Continue Reading at GameSpot
